detail.longDescription:
Curseforge: Skins Editor for MCPE is your ultimate source for high-quality Minecraft Pocket Edition content. Discover the Best Addons, Maps and Skins - all in one convenient app.

What you’ll find inside:
- Popular Minecraft PE Addons with new mobs, items, and mechanics
- Unique maps for survival, adventure, and creative gameplay
- Stylish skins to customize your character
- Regularly updated content from the community

New Feature: Skin Editor
Now you can not only explore skins, but also create and edit your own directly in the app:
- Edit skins with pixel-level precision
- Draw and customize every detail
- Use simple tools to create unique designs
- Save and use your custom skins anytime

New Feature: Skin Preview Customization
Now you can take your skins to the next level with advanced preview controls. Adjust how your character looks before using it:
- Rotate your character from any angle
- Change poses for arms and legs
- Create dynamic and unique stances
- Capture the perfect screenshot to share with friends

This feature is designed to help you present your skins in the best possible way and create eye-catching previews for sharing and showcasing.

Easy & Fast:
All add-ons are easy to browse and install. No complicated steps - just choose, download, and enjoy your upgraded Minecraft PE experience.
Why choose this app:
- Curated add-ons
- Simple interface
- Frequent updates
- Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock / Pocket Edition


Whether you love survival challenges, creative builds, or visual customization - this app helps you build your perfect world.
